title: CPL Changes Start Times for Two Warriors Matches on 6 September
description: The CPL and WCPL have changed the start times of two Guyana Amazon Warriors fixtures scheduled for Sunday, 6 September 2026.
dek: The WCPL match at Kensington Oval moves to 10am, while the men's CPL match in Guyana moves to 3pm local time.
image_alt: CPL fixture update for Guyana Amazon Warriors matches on 6 September
summary_heading: Morning and afternoon slots revised for two Warriors fixtures
key_points: Guyana Amazon Warriors vs Jamaica Empress now starts at 10am at Kensington Oval.
Guyana Amazon Warriors vs St Kitts and Nevis Patriots now starts at 3pm at Guyana National Stadium.
Barbados Tridents vs Saint Lucia Kings remains at 7pm.

sections.heading: WCPL fixture moves to 10am
paragraphs: The Limacol WCPL match between Guyana Amazon Warriors and Jamaica Empress at Kensington Oval has moved from 2pm to 10am local time on Sunday, 6 September.
The wider women's tournament context is available in the WCPL 2026 fixtures announcement.

sections.heading: Men's Warriors match moves to 3pm
paragraphs: The men's CPL fixture between Guyana Amazon Warriors and St Kitts and Nevis Patriots at Guyana National Stadium has moved from 10am to 3pm local time.
Supporters should use the updated CPL 2026 schedule and Warriors team page when planning the day.

sections.heading: Evening match remains unchanged
paragraphs: Barbados Tridents against Saint Lucia Kings at Kensington Oval remains scheduled for 7pm on the same date. No change was announced for that fixture.

The revised sequence places the WCPL game first in Barbados, the men's Warriors fixture in Guyana during the afternoon and the Tridents-Kings contest in the evening. All announced times are local to the venue.
Ground information is available in the CPL venue guide.
